summary: Index anchored ingestion artifacts through derived embedding services.

input_schema.ingestion_id: string | The ingestion identifier whose anchored artifacts should be indexed.
input_schema.indexing_run_id: string | The ingestion-owned indexing run identifier to update.

output_schema.ingestion_id: string | The ingestion identifier that was indexed.
output_schema.indexing_run_id: string | The ingestion-owned indexing run identifier.
output_schema.source_count: integer | Number of Embedding sources created or updated.
output_schema.chunk_count: integer | Number of chunks created or updated.
output_schema.embedding_count: integer | Number of embedding vectors persisted.
output_schema.failed_count: integer | Number of anchored artifacts that failed indexing.
